newsitem.title: GERMANY: New Guatamalan airline to launch early February.
newsitem.headline: New Guatamalan airline to launch early February.

text.p: Start-up carrier Mayan World Airlines will launch its first scheduled flights in early February, European aircraft manufacturer Aero International (Regional) said.
The Guatemalan airline will use two renovated ATR 42 turboprop aircraft to fly between Guatemala City and Flores, close to the Mayan ruins of Tikal, an AI(R) statement said.
The first aircraft was delivered at the end of January and the second in early February.
Mayan World Airlines plans to expand its network to neighbouring states, opening new direct regional connections for business travellers, AI(R) said.
The airline's project consultant, Santiago de la Rocha, said the carrier decided to launch with ATR 42 aircraft due to their low operating costs and global service back-up.
AI(R) is responsible for sales and marketing of aircraft of its joint owners, Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc and Italian manufacturer Alenia.
